1. **packages/features/bookings/components/PeopleFilter.tsx, useEffect block** — Side-effecting filter logic is placed in a UI component that's used purely for rendering a people-picker popover; this mutates URL/query state as a render side effect, conflating "org admin" (`currentOrg?.user.role`) with "instance/system admin" per the issue (#18026 asks for Cal.com instance admins, not org admins). Fix: clarify which admin concept is intended (likely `me.role === "ADMIN"`, the system role, not org role) and move default-filter logic to wherever bookings query params are initialized (e.g., `useFilterQuery` or the bookings list page), not into a filter-dropdown component.

2. **Infinite loop / unwanted re-push risk** — `pushItemToKey("userIds", me.id)` runs in a `useEffect` keyed on `query.userIds`, and `removeAllQueryParams`/`removeItemByKeyAndValue` elsewhere set `userIds` back to empty/undefined when the admin explicitly clicks "all". Since the effect re-fires whenever `query.userIds` becomes empty again, clearing the filter will be immediately overwritten by the effect, making "admin can still remove the filter" (as claimed in the PR description) not actually work. Fix: add a one-time/initialized guard (e.g., a ref or a separate "hasAppliedDefault" flag) so the default is only applied once per mount, not re-applied whenever the array becomes empty.

3. **Component placement / duplication** — This default-filter behavior will presumably need to apply across any other booking list views/filters (e.g., filter pills, saved filter segments) and currently only lives inside `PeopleFilter`, a dropdown UI component instantiated potentially multiple times/places. Embedding business/default-behavior logic in a leaf UI component is fragile and will silently stop working if `PeopleFilter` is reused or reordered relative to other filter components. Fix: lift default-user-filter logic to a shared hook/page-level effect (e.g., inside the bookings list page or `useFilterQuery`) so it's applied once regardless of which filter components render.

4. **No test coverage** — The PR only claims "verified through code review," with no unit/e2e test added despite this being a behavior change to a widely-used component, and it affects both org and (likely) global admin contexts. Fix: add at least one unit test (React Testing Library) verifying default filter applies for admins and does not override an explicit "all" selection, plus an e2e/Playwright test given this is flagged as a core workflow.

5. **Settings/opt-out missing** — Per house convention for behavior-changing defaults affecting all admins, there's no way to persist the admin's preference (e.g., if they always clear it, it comes back on next page load since nothing is saved) — the effect runs on every mount with `query.userIds` undefined initially. Fix: either persist the choice (e.g., in local storage or user preference) or confirm with design whether "always default on load" is actually the desired UX before merging, since the linked issue's screenshot suggests a one-time inconvenience, not an in-session persistence requirement.
